result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one major layout problem where content is obscured by the bottom navigation, and one minor clipping issue in the horizontal restaurant carousel.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card is cut off by the bottom navigation bar, making the content appear hidden and harder to access.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/scroll space so list items clear the fixed navigation bar, or make the content area scroll above the nav.

issues.description: The rightmost restaurant card in the "Fastest near you" row is partially clipped off-screen, so the card feels incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal carousel spacing or card width so partially visible items are intentional and more clearly indicate horizontal scrolling.
